metaTitle: Custom Recycled Luggage ID Tags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Brand custom recycled luggage ID tags for eco-conscious bulk orders. Perfect for trade shows and employee gifts.
introHtml: Made from post-consumer recycled felt, these custom recycled luggage ID tags offer a sustainable alternative for businesses looking to reduce their environmental footprint. Unlike standard plastic tags, the recycled felt material provides a soft, durable surface that accepts full-color screen printing or debossing, making your logo stand out. Ideal for corporate gifts, trade show giveaways, or employee recognition, these tags pair eco-friendly messaging with practical use. Each tag includes a clear ID window and adjustable strap for secure attachment to any bag.
heroAltText: Custom recycled luggage ID tags made from recycled felt with a clear ID window and adjustable strap.
